suitPayment: Pay a 70% advance before production. For a suit order, the balance is due when tailoring is complete, before final cleaning and delivery. Full payment is required before garment release.
standalonePayment: Standalone alterations and cleaning require a 70% advance. With that advance, the remaining 30% is payable when the service is complete, before release or delivery. For standalone cleaning, this means after cleaning is complete.
balance: With a 70% advance, the balance is 30%. Your actual balance is the agreed total less payments already received.
contents: A standard two-piece suit includes a jacket and trousers. A standard three-piece includes a jacket, trousers and waistcoat. A shirt is not automatically included. Skirt-suit options require a separate quotation and confirmation; the standard trouser-package price must not be assumed.
package: The standard suit package includes the agreed suit and standard tailoring, a branded hanger and protective cover, one initial standard professional cleaning, and initial door-to-door delivery within Kigali. These included items are not charged separately again.
extras: Extra fabric, decorations, embroidery, attachments and special requirements need a quotation and confirmation before payment.
higherCollections: For Polyester, Wool/Star and Super/Americano collection enquiries, request a quotation. No prices for these collections are listed here. Collection names alone do not establish verified fabric composition.
delivery: Initial door-to-door Kigali delivery is included with the standard suit package. Outside-Kigali courier or agency charges are customer-paid and confirmed before dispatch. A courier deadline must be confirmed individually. Mobile fittings, collection visits and follow-up transport are separate arrangements; confirm their scope and any charges directly.
timing: Standard tailoring usually takes 2–4 days; express tailoring usually takes 12–15 hours. These are tailoring-stage estimates, not delivered-suit deadlines. Sourcing, scheduling, fittings, changes, final cleaning and delivery affect the full order timeline. Confirm a realistic completion date individually.
alterationTiming: Alterations are usually completed within one maker day. This is a work-stage estimate, not a guaranteed handover time; confirm assessment, scheduling, fitting and delivery arrangements individually.
careTiming: Confirm the cleaning service, suitability and estimated completion date with the team before proceeding. The full schedule depends on the garment, treatment and current capacity.
